kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Ottoman Turkish دشمه (deşme, “an opening or a thing dug into”), the resultative noun from Ottoman Turkish دشمك (deşmek, “to cleave, to puncture”), from Proto-Turkic *teĺ- (“to make holes”).
s: Ottoman Turkish دشمه (deşme, “an opening or a thing dug into”)
Ottoman Turkish دشمك (deşmek, “to cleave, to puncture”)
